objective.statement: Change the footer's last-updated label from "Last updated <time>" to "Was last updated <time>".

complexity.rationale: One literal string in one presentational component plus test assertion updates; no logic, state, dependency or contract change.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: The footer renders "Was last updated <time>" instead of "Last updated <time>".
Existing footer test assertions expect the new text, and a regression test asserts the footer renders "Was last updated <time>".
Timestamp logic, relative-time formatting, the version label, styling and layout are unchanged.

in.statement: Test assertions expecting the old text (footer component test and the App test that asserts the footer text), plus one regression test.

out.statement: Timestamp logic, formatRelativeTime, the version label, styling and layout.

observations.statement: The card says "the existing footer test assertion" but the old text is asserted in several places (five in the footer component test, one in src/App.component.test.tsx). All of them are updated to the new text, otherwise they would fail; no other behaviour is touched.

provenance.source: Card: Bug Fix - Footer shows the wrong "last updated" label.
Card names one test assertion but old text is asserted in six places; conservative choice is to update every assertion of the old text.

capabilityOwners.rationale: Static label text; the footer clock state is untouched.

component.rationale: Rendered footer text is the behaviour under fix.

integration.rationale: App test asserts the footer text; it is updated and the full suite is run as regression.

e2e.rationale: Static text in an already component-tested footer.

increments.doneWhen: Updated and regression footer tests pass, the full suite is green, and tsc and eslint are clean.

tests.description: LastUpdatedFooter renders "Was last updated <time>" (regression), and existing assertions expect the new text.

expectedRedEvidence.expectedFailure: Expected element to have text content "Was last updated just now" but received "Last updated just now".
expectedRedEvidence.observedFailure: 7 of 8 footer tests failed: expected "Was last updated just now", received "Last updated just now"

verification.requirement: Full test suite, build and lint pass.
verification.result: unit 30/30 and component 51/51 passed; npm run build and npm run lint clean
